recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. If the work group later resolves FHIR-54632 about the documentType value set, handle that as a separate decision rather than expanding this R5 clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-39394 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for FHIR-core Consent. It requested clarifying Consent.provision.code as clinical-code filtering with a LOINC example binding excluding document-scale codes, renaming Consent.provision.class to Consent.provision.documentType with a preferred document-type binding, and adding Consent.provision.resourceType bound to FHIR resource types with 0..* cardinality.
initial_application: PR #2450 from HL7/Consent-Jira-39394 and commit 3d15d8f10db9fb3f2f57469a3fa986e3baebc1f0 applied the main split by replacing class with documentType, adding resourceType, updating bindings/cardinalities, removing the misleading .code comment, and splitting LOINC document versus non-document value sets. Commit 064d2b030b55d6565b49bc9d153799d2f7a13cb9 later normalized the LOINC Doc filter value to LP32888-7.
additional_context: Consent is active in source/fhir.ini, and the R4 map records Consent.provision.class=@Consent.provision.resourceType. Later Consent QA and search-parameter issues did not supersede this split; FHIR-41456 is already represented on the combined branch, and FHIR-54632 remains only Triaged/unresolved.
reconciliation: Updated source/consent/structuredefinition-Consent.xml to replace documentType's resource/profile short text, narrow resourceType wording to FHIR resource types, apply the approved clinical-code description to code, and remove stale binding prose saying an exception applies.
source_changes: source/consent/structuredefinition-Consent.xml: clarified Consent.provision.documentType, Consent.provision.resourceType, and Consent.provision.code definitions/descriptions to match the FHIR-39394 split.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied issue added a Consent.provision.code search parameter; it is already represented on the combined branch and did not change this element-definition wording.
